title: Chapter 111 Invincible Posture
content:
Chapter 111 Invincible Posture

"Haha, hahahaha,"

At this time, a hearty laugh rang out from the stone tower.

Accompanied by its unique aura, the laughter spread directly throughout the Golden Immortal Realm.

"Interesting, interesting."

"I haven't seen such an arrogant person for a long time."

The next moment, a white-haired man suddenly appeared above the sky, and the terrifying imperial power suddenly poured down from the sky.

Boom!

In an instant, the entire Golden Immortal Realm fell into a brief silence, and then it completely broke out.

"Emperor Yuan! He, he is still alive!"

"This person is still in the Golden Immortal Realm!"

"Now there is a good show to watch. Emperor Yuan, who was invincible in the realm of the Immortal Emperor back then, probably has to teach this arrogant guy a lesson."

Seeing the figure of Emperor Yuan, the world suddenly became excited.

In that era, Emperor Yuan explained what it meant to be invincible at the same level.

Born in the same era as Emperor Yuan, it is a mixture of sadness and joy.

The sad thing is that no matter how hard you work and how talented you are, you can only be a foil in the end.

The good news is that Emperor Yuan made people understand what the limit of combat power is.

After so many years, Emperor Yuan reappeared, and some of the older generation of strong men suddenly felt difficulty breathing, and the suffocating feeling of being oppressed and unable to breathe reappeared.

In the void, Lu Daosheng turned his head to look at Yan Lingyun and smiled: "Lingyun, what do you think of this person?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's question, Yan Lingyun was slightly stunned, obviously did not expect Lu Daosheng to ask her.

Looking at Emperor Yuan in the distance, Yan Lingyun was silent for a moment, nodded slightly and said: "It's okay."

It's okay.

Just okay.

This sentence instantly froze Emperor Yuan's smile in the distance.

In the eyes of others, he is just okay?

This made Emperor Yuan a little unhappy.

At this time, Lu Daosheng on the side had already stepped forward and instantly appeared not far in front of Emperor Yuan.

"I'll give you a chance, take action."

Lu Daosheng looked at Emperor Yuan and said directly.

Hearing this, an inexplicable fire slowly burned in the heart of Emperor Yuan.

"You do have some strength, but you are so arrogant. You don't know that in the eyes of others, you are just a clown."

"Oh, well, let me let you feel what a real strong man is."

Emperor Yuan sneered, and then countless avenues gathered in his hands, transforming into a series of light wheels that revealed a terrifying aura. Emperor Yuan raised his arms, and suddenly, countless avenue light wheels began to overlap.

"Ten thousand light elements!"

This move is Emperor Yuan's famous skill.

Back then, Emperor Yuan successfully fought against three with ten thousand light elements, severely injuring three immortal emperors, and became famous in one battle!

And now, after endless years, this move reappears in the world again.

"I am lucky enough to see the famous skills of Emperor Yuan, and I have no regrets in this life."

"This guy dares to claim to be invincible. Haha, not to mention that he can defeat Emperor Yuan, if he can take Emperor Yuan's attack, I will lick the whole city directly."

"Emperor Yuan's strength is not less than that of the past, and it is even better."

Seeing the ten thousand light sources, the world was immediately filled with emotion.

Obviously, all the practitioners in the entire Golden Immortal Realm were just paying attention to this battle, fearing that they would miss any details.

All the strong men knew that Lu Daosheng was not weak either, and the terrifying aura alone explained everything.

However, Emperor Yuan's invincible posture had long been imprinted in their minds.

They all felt that Emperor Yuan would win.

At this time, accompanied by a flash of light.

The entire Golden Immortal Realm actually trembled slightly at this moment.

Boom!

Suddenly, the light wheel condensed and overlapped by the power of countless avenues rushed towards Lu Daosheng.

Wherever he passed, the entire space completely turned into nothingness.

At this time, Emperor Yuan had already revealed a smile of victory. Under his move, no one had ever been able to take it safely.

This was his confidence.

However, Emperor Yuan also recognized Lu Daosheng's strength, because in such a long time, Lu Daosheng was the first opponent who made him feel oppressed.

This was why he used his ultimate move right at the beginning.

In the distance, Lu Daosheng had a blank expression on his face.

It must be said that this attack was very strong. Ordinary immortal emperors might even fall in the face of this attack, and if they did not die, they would be seriously injured.

And the white-haired man in front of him, who was called Emperor Yuan, had also reached the limit of the immortal emperor realm, and was only one step away from the next step.

But this step was extremely difficult.

The difficulty made Emperor Yuan retreat and ponder for tens of millions of years, but he still did not take this step.

But today, he was able to fulfill his wish.

Lu Daosheng slowly raised his hand, then clenched it into a fist and punched out.

It was just an ordinary punch, without any external force, but it instantly made the smile of the Yuan Emperor in the distance disappear.

Boom!

The terrifying explosion sounded, and the entire Golden Immortal Realm was violently shaken.

Even the origin of the entire Golden Immortal Realm was greatly affected. Obviously, the Golden Immortal Realm could no longer withstand this fluctuation.

And the ten thousand light elements, under the unbelievable eyes of the world, shattered into nothingness.

The fist light had no obstruction and went straight to the Yuan Emperor in the distance.

Facing this punch, the Yuan Emperor had no power to resist.

From the time he embarked on the road of cultivation to now, the Yuan Emperor felt what despair was for the first time.

Boom!

Another explosion sounded.

The smoke cleared, and the Yuan Emperor was lying flat in the void, but even so, the terrifying imperial power still frightened the world.

The Yuan Emperor was defeated!

And it was killed instantly.

At this moment, the world finally understood what Lu Daosheng said, "I'll give you a chance, make a move."

It turned out that if this existence in front of him had made a move at the beginning, the Yuan Emperor would not even have a chance to make a move.

Where did this terrifying existence come from, and why had it never been heard of before.

Could it be from the outside world?

Looking at the Yuan Emperor lying in the void, Lu Daosheng casually threw down a crystal stone emitting a strong breath. Suddenly, the crystal stone emitted pure energy and began to flow into the body of the Yuan Emperor.

At this moment, the Yuan Emperor began to transform.

The real reason why he failed to take the last step out of the Immortal Emperor Realm was that he had never tasted the feeling of failure.

He couldn't find a way forward.

And now, Lu Daosheng gave him a chance.

Since then, Emperor Yuan's cultivation path has become more transparent. If he can figure it out thoroughly, then Emperor Yuan's strength will be completely changed!

Seeing the crystal stone next to Emperor Yuan, countless beings in the dark immediately coveted it.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly said: "If anyone dares to touch him, I will visit him."

Emperor Yuan had no grudges against him, so it was reasonable for him to use him to show off, and it was reasonable to give him some benefits.

Then, Lu Daosheng slowly left.

As soon as these words came out, the thoughts that those beings in the dark had just generated disappeared instantly.

They were just a little greedy, but life was still the most important.

At this time, the entire Golden Immortal Realm was silent.

Because at this moment, their faith had collapsed a little.

Now they really understand what it means that there are people beyond people and there are heavens beyond heavens.

Even a figure like Emperor Yuan is no exception.

"Hey, where did the guy who said he would lick the city go?"

"That guy cut off his tongue."

"Fuck, what a ruthless person!"

......

"Lingyun, how is it?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng returned to Yan Lingyun and smiled faintly.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun lowered her head and said nothing.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng laughed and said, "Don't worry, follow me and continue."

It has to be said that this guy is really a bit cool, and he himself likes this feeling a little bit.

Then, Lu Daosheng's breath began to surge again, as if there was no limit.
